thread:
emma.marketing: Quick heads-up — final pass on the product launch post. Need to lock voice/tone on hero + the benchmarks section. Target publish Tue 3pm PT. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft-launch (please add inline comments). Also need CTA + webinar routing confirmed.

taylor.writer: On it. Do we want the hero to be more technical (latency/cost numbers) or outcome-focused (what customers get)? I wrote two headline variants in the doc.

rajesh.product: Lean outcome-focused but keep a short technical subhead. Recommend we call out "up to 3x lower latency" and "~40% lower per-token cost" but add a one-line caveat: "based on internal synthetic workloads; results vary by model and workload." I'll drop the benchmark tables into the appendix.

noah.design: Will prepare hero comps for both headline styles. For the post layout, suggest CTA slot above the fold + persistent sticky CTA on mobile. Uploaded roughs to the drive — https://drive.google.com/hero-variants.

olivia.legal: Quick flag — "up to 3x" is okay with a clear caveat and link to test methodology. Don't use absolute phrasing like "3x faster" without backup. Also, any customer quotes used need explicit sign-off.

emma.marketing: Good call @olivia. We'll switch to "up to 3x" and include the appendix link. @taylor please add the benchmark caveat as the sentence Rajesh suggested.

rajesh.product: Appendix link (internal test doc): https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/launch-v1 — includes test harness and config. Use it for legal verification.

taylor.writer: Updated the doc: changed to "up to 3x" and added the appendix link + short micro-FAQ about methodology. Also added headline variants: 1) "Production LLM inference with predictable latency" 2) "Ship features faster with predictable cost" — comments welcome.

noah.design: Quick note on imagery — avoid literal GPU photos. Thinking abstract latency graph + product screenshot. Mobile crop tested.

emma.marketing: Webinar CTA — plan is: 1) inline CTA in post -> registration modal, 2) end-of-post CTA -> full signup page. Leads should map to HubSpot list "Launch Webinar - Blog" and tag with "source:blog" + campaign UTMs. Anyone can confirm mapping?

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish jobs must be created at least 48 hours before target time. Use /schedule-publish when ready.

taylor.writer: HubSpot mapping snippet I'm adding to the doc:
```
formId: 'hs_launch_2024',
fields: ['email','company','job_title','use_case'],
list: 'Launch Webinar - Blog',
tags: ['source:blog','campaign:launch_apr24']
```
Will append example UTMs: `?utm_campaign=launch_apr24&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=referral`.

olivia.legal: Confirmed: mapping looks fine. Just make sure we don't auto-enroll into sales sequences without consent — needs opt-in copy on the registration form.

emma.marketing: Noted. We'll keep opt-in language and add a consent checkbox. @taylor can you add the micro-copy?

taylor.writer: Added: "I agree to receive emails about product updates and the Redwood launch webinar." Short and clear.

rajesh.product: Small wording ask for hero subhead: include "unified runtime + predictable economics" so it ties to product messaging.

taylor.writer: Done — merged that into the second headline variant. Also tightened lead-in paragraph to call out reliability and rollback policies.

noah.design: Dropped final hero assets (3 colorways) into the drive and added alt text. Please pick one by EOD Monday.

emma.marketing: Plan: legal pass today, design pick Monday, final copy freeze Monday EOD, schedule publish with ops Tuesday morning, publish Tue 3pm PT. If that timeline works, I'll lock this thread for final approvals. :rocket: 

olivia.legal: I'll finish the review in the doc by 4pm PT and leave any redlines.

rajesh.product: Approved on content and numbers pending legal's redlines. :thumbsup:

taylor.writer: Will prepare the webinar registration page copy and corresponding UTM'd links.

noah.design: +1, will hand off final hero and mobile crops after legal.

emma.marketing: Thanks all. If no major legal blockers, I'll /schedule-publish and loop in ops for the runbook. Final ask: drop any last comments in the doc — I'll do a last sweep at 5pm PT. :spiral_notepad:"
